description: Ministry of  Health & Indigenous Medical Services - The Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID 19) (Elections) Regulations, No. 1 of 2020
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance, establishing legal requirements for election activities during COVID-19. It creates new regulatory requirements for election meetings, canvassing, and polling station operations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
